description: This file defines the MergeRecord class, which manages the merging process of records within the SuiteCRM platform. It handles loading of related beans, constructing search parameters, and building SQL queries for merging records.

classes.name: MergeRecord
classes.description: Manages merging of records by loading beans, constructing search and where clauses, and facilitating the merge process within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MergeRecord object and optionally loads a merge bean with specified module and ID.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a bean record by ID, with special handling for the 'Step2' action.

methods.name: load_merge_bean
methods.description: Loads a bean from a specified module and optionally retrieves a record by ID.

methods.name: load_merge_bean2
methods.description: Loads a second bean from a specified module and optionally retrieves a record by ID.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Delegates to the merge bean to fill list view fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Delegates to the merge bean to fill detail view fields.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a summary text provided by the merge bean.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Returns list view data from the merge bean.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a generic SQL WHERE clause from a query string using the merge bean.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a given interface; currently used for 'ACL'.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions on the merge bean for given actions.

methods.name: populate_search_params
methods.description: Populates search parameters array based on input search parameters.

methods.name: get_inputs_for_search_params
methods.description: Generates hidden HTML input fields for search parameters.

methods.name: email_addresses_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query fragment to find email addresses excluding a specified bean ID.

methods.name: release_name_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL clause for release name search based on type (like, start, exact).

methods.name: create_where_statement
methods.description: Assembles an SQL WHERE clause from multiple search conditions.

methods.name: generate_where_statement
methods.description: Combines multiple WHERE clauses into a single string joined by AND.
